text: 40岁左右中年人的感觉就是不敢出错。
en: For those around forty, being middle-aged means simply not daring to make a mistake.

text: 上有老下有小的越来越觉得自己要保养好身体，不能因为身体原因而影响家庭。
en: With ageing parents above and young children below, one increasingly feels the need to look after one's health, and not let physical problems affect the family.

text: 要努力赚钱，同时开通副业。
en: One must strive to earn money, while also starting a side business.

text: 在第一份收入稳定的时候赶紧开副业，因为有备无患啊。
en: When the first stream of income becomes stable, one should quickly start a side business, because being prepared guards against want.

text: 要培养好自己的人际关系，一个好的圈子是生存的必须条件。
en: One must cultivate good interpersonal relationships; a good circle is a necessary condition for survival.

text: 走过半生，要珍惜眼前的一切。
en: Having walked halfway through life, one should cherish everything before one's eyes.

text: 以平常心看待一切。
en: Regard everything with an ordinary mind.

text: 活着就要感恩。
en: To live is to be grateful.

text: 40岁的人肯定有很多人生体会。
en: A person of forty surely has much life experience.

text: 但千万不要把自己划归中年人的行列！
en: But never classify yourself into the ranks of the middle-aged!

text: 那样会很影响心态。
en: That would greatly affect one's state of mind.

text: 40岁的中年人还有希望吗？
en: Do middle-aged people of forty still have hope?

text: 人到四十，无论男女，好像一切变得停滞不前。
en: When one reaches forty, regardless of man or woman, everything seems to come to a standstill.

text: 打工的工资不涨，身体日益发福，指标个个爆红，生活也是一成不变。
en: Wages from employment do not rise, the body grows stout by the day, every health indicator flares red, and life remains unchanged.

text: 一眼就能望到退休时的凄惨光景，似乎看不到变好的迹象，40岁到底还有没有希望？
en: One can see at a glance the miserable scene at retirement; there seems to be no sign of improvement. After all, do those of forty still have hope?

text: 总是喜欢人比人，先来看看历史上40岁还没有发迹的男人们，给自己打打鸡血。
en: Always fond of comparing oneself with others, let us first look at the men in history who had not yet risen to prominence at forty, to give ourselves a pep talk.

text: 刘邦40岁还只是一个街溜子；
en: At forty, Bang Liu was still just a street loafer;

text: 刘备40岁连安身之所都没有；
en: At forty, Bei Liu did not even have a place to settle down;

text: 黄忠六十岁才得遇明主；
en: It was only at sixty that Zhong Huang met a wise master;

text: 姜子牙八十岁才出山；
en: It was only at eighty that Ziya Jiang came out of retirement to serve;

text: 其实40岁才开始发迹是有道理的。
en: In fact, it makes sense that one only begins to prosper at forty.

text: 人到了40岁，该经历的人生大事也都经历了，就算资质愚笨，大部分人也陆续开始开窍了。
en: By the time one reaches forty, the major events of life one ought to experience have been experienced; even if one's aptitude is dull, most people gradually begin to become enlightened.

text: 不是有句话：三十而立，四十不惑。
en: Is there not a saying: at thirty one stands firm, at forty one is free of doubts.

text: 40岁的人，看透了人情冷暖，看透了职场规则，人生阅历变得丰富，心理素质稳如泰山。
en: A person of forty has seen through the warmth and coldness of human relationships and seen through the rules of the workplace; life experience becomes rich, and psychological fortitude is as steady as Mount Tai.

text: 无论遇到啥事，都不会像年轻时那么容易冲动，情绪非常稳定，用理性全面思考，做起事来自然也能得心应手。
en: Whatever happens, one will not be as easily impulsive as in youth; one's emotions are very stable, one thinks comprehensively with reason, and naturally one can handle things with ease.

text: 有时候，少年得志不见得是好事。
en: Sometimes, early success is not necessarily a good thing.

text: 年少得志，心高气傲，很容易遭受重大错误。
en: Achieving success when young, with a proud and arrogant heart, one easily makes grave mistakes.

text: 反而是40岁的中年人，前期多多少少接受了一些人生教训，比如失恋，失业，离婚，亲友离世…
en: On the contrary, middle-aged people of forty, having more or less absorbed some life lessons earlier—such as lost love, unemployment, divorce, the passing of relatives and friends—

text: 知道了人生充满喜悦和悲伤，有成功也有失败，心态就会豁达很多，为人处世多了几份成熟。
en: Knowing that life is full of joy and sorrow, with both success and failure, one's mindset becomes much more open-minded, and one gains a measure of maturity in dealing with others.

text: 世俗的成功，要么名要么利，你都可以去追求。
en: Worldly success, whether fame or fortune, you may pursue either.

text: 职场上，你尽管去干，完全可以凭借多年的资历谋求一官半职。
en: In the workplace, you may simply go ahead and work; you can entirely rely on years of seniority to seek an official post or title.

text: 如果你能享受职场的环境，那么也未尝不可。
en: If you can enjoy the workplace environment, then it is not a bad idea either.

text: 但是，成功没有被绝对定义，每个人心中的成功千差万别。
en: But success is not absolutely defined; the success in each person's heart differs vastly.

text: 在我看来所谓成功，就是我能做自己最热爱也最擅长的事，不仅在做事的过程中获得乐趣，还能找到心灵的归宿，同时还能获得收益，并以此为生。
en: In my view, so-called success means being able to do what I love most and am best at—not only finding joy in the process of doing it, but also discovering a spiritual home, while also gaining income and making a living from it.

text: 当然，40岁有没有希望，最终还是取决于你自己。
en: Of course, whether one has hope at forty ultimately depends on yourself.

text: 首先不要怀疑自己，认为这辈子就这样了。
en: First, do not doubt yourself, thinking that this is all life will be.

text: 也不要拒绝成长，认为自己不可再造了。
en: Nor refuse to grow, believing oneself beyond remaking.

text: 其实机会很多，只是你的认知遮盖了你的双眼。
en: In fact, there are many opportunities; it is only your perception that blinds your eyes.

text: 写公众号也好，做产品也好，卖服务也行，就算展现和分享自己的兴趣也是一种方式。
en: Whether writing a public account, making a product, or selling a service, even showing and sharing one's interests is a kind of method.

text: 多用虚怀若谷的心态去接纳新事物，并找到方向。
en: Adopt a mind as empty as a valley more often, to accept new things and find direction.

text: 至于能不能坚持，那就只能靠你的定力了。
en: As for whether you can persist, that depends solely on your determination.

text: 文章首发于公众号 ：唐宋的成长圈
en: The article was first published on the public account: Song Tang's Growth Circle

text: 很想有正能量的回答，但是现实是真实的，熬粥不是靠嘴说要有米要有水，现实很残酷，现在大形势就是不好失业率只会越来越高，而且以后会更难，因为ai的兴起和发展真的很多工作可以替代了，最明显的就是腾讯客服啥时候能找到人工客服？
en: I really wanted a positive, uplifting answer, but reality is real; making congee is not done by words alone—one needs rice and water. Reality is cruel. The general situation now is simply poor; unemployment will only grow higher and higher, and it will be even harder later, because the rise and development of AI can truly replace many jobs. The most obvious example: when can one ever find a human customer service agent at Tencent?

text: 其实这个ai发展是全球性的，所以以后只会更难。
en: In fact, this AI development is global, so it will only become harder later.

text: 别说去创业，拿什么创，创什么，不是人人都能创业，创业有门槛，天天那些嘴上说着创业卖课割韭菜的其实这就是他们的创业，能创业的是本来就有门路的或者已经打工摸索出经验的。
en: Not to mention starting a business—with what does one start, and what does one start? Not everyone can start a business; entrepreneurship has a threshold. Those who go around every day talking about entrepreneurship and selling courses to harvest leeks—that itself is their entrepreneurship. Those who can truly start a business are those who already had connections or had already gained experience groping through employment.

text: 如果上了半辈子班都是螺丝钉式工作，真的除了快车外卖没好办法。
en: If one has spent half a lifetime at work doing screw-type jobs, truly there is no good option apart from ride-hailing or food delivery.

text: 就感觉除了上班还是很自由
en: One just feels that apart from going to work, it is still quite free.

text: 人活着自在很重要
en: For a person, living at ease is very important.

text: 不贪心 不做违背自己心的事儿
en: Do not be greedy; do not do things that go against one's own heart.

text: 一位受人欢迎的40岁中年人的生活感悟：熟谙人性，只有一个方法。
en: The life insight of a popular forty-year-old middle-aged person: to know human nature thoroughly, there is only one method.

text: 这个方法就是不断积累经验，因为经验是最好的老师，是我们曾经所走过的路的累积。
en: This method is to keep accumulating experience, because experience is the best teacher, the accumulation of the paths we have walked.

text: 这位中年人用他的剪发的经历来阐述这个道理，读来很有趣，下面就来具体了解下吧。
en: This middle-aged person used his experience of having his hair cut to illustrate this principle; it makes for interesting reading, so let us look at it in detail below.

text: 这位中年人虽然已经到了40岁的不惑之年，但仍是风度翩翩、极具魅力，他的人缘非常之好，不管走到哪里，都是人群当中最受人瞩目和欢迎的人物。
en: Although this middle-aged person has reached the age of forty, the age of no doubts, he remains graceful and extremely charming; he is very well liked, and wherever he goes, he is the most noticed and welcomed figure in the crowd.

text: 有一天，这位中年男子参加老同学的聚会，茶余饭后，大家聊着聊着，不觉之间，便将话题转到了他的身上。
en: One day, this middle-aged man attended a reunion of old classmates. After tea and a meal, as everyone chatted away, before they realised it, the topic turned to him.

text: 同学们都非常好奇，为什么从学生时代开始，他就是那么具有魅力的人物，如今他的吸引力非但丝毫未减，还与日俱增，这其中有什么秘密呢？
en: The classmates were all very curious: why, from his school days, had he been such a charismatic figure, and now his appeal had not diminished in the slightest but grew day by day—what was the secret?

text: 一群老同学围着这位中年人，大家纷纷起哄着，一定要他说出自己深具魅力、深受欢迎的秘密。
en: A group of old classmates surrounded this middle-aged person, all clamouring and insisting that he reveal the secret of his deep charm and great popularity.

text: 中年人起先并不愿意透露，言不及意地说着一些他的优点，比如个性乐观、笑口常开、乐于助人、幽默风趣等，明显是想敷衍过去，但众人根本不为所动，坚持要他说出真正的秘诀到底是什么。
en: The middle-aged person was at first unwilling to reveal it, and spoke evasively about some of his merits—such as an optimistic character, a constant smile, willingness to help others, humour and wit—obviously trying to gloss over it, but the crowd was unmoved and insisted he tell them what the true secret really was.

text: 到了最后，中年人实在受逼不过，只好摊开双手，耸了耸肩道：“好吧，你们先看看我，我整个人看起来最让你舒服的地方，在哪里？
en: In the end, the middle-aged person, truly pressed beyond endurance, had no choice but to spread his hands, shrug his shoulders, and say: "All right, look at me first—where on my whole person do you find the place that makes you most comfortable?"

text: 同学们观察了许久，猜了衣着、脸型、笑容…
en: The classmates observed for a long while, guessing at his clothing, face shape and smile…

text: 这位中年人都摇头不语。
en: This middle-aged person simply shook his head and said nothing.

text: 最后有个老同学说了：“是发型？
en: At last an old classmate said: "Is it the hairstyle?

text: 中年人大笑道：“对！
en: The middle-aged person laughed loudly and said: "Right!

text: 就是我的发型！
en: It is my hairstyle!

text: ”大家这时才仔细地看着他的头发，的确是看起来很舒服又很自然，也很漂亮。
en: " Only then did everyone carefully look at his hair; indeed it looked very comfortable and natural, and also quite beautiful.

text: 这时有个同学，连忙问道：“你的头发都是在哪里剪的？
en: At this point a classmate hurriedly asked: "Where do you always get your hair cut?

text: 可不可以帮我们介绍一下，好让我们也去见识下？
en: Could you introduce us, so we too can go and see for ourselves?

text: 中年人微笑道：“我并没有固定的地方，也没有固定的理发师，重要的是我一向都是找理发店中发型最差的理发师来帮我理发。
en: The middle-aged person smiled and said: "I have no fixed place, nor a fixed barber; what matters is that I always seek out the worst hairstylist in the barbershop to cut my hair for me.

text: 众人好奇地问道：“啊，这是为什么呀？
en: The crowd asked curiously: "Ah, but why is that?

text: 中年人答道：“你们不知道吗？
en: The middle-aged person answered: "Do you not know?

text: 他们理发师之间都是互相修剪对方的头发啊！
en: The barbers all cut each other's hair!

text: 同学们这才明白过来，然后又陷入沉思中…
en: Only then did the classmates understand, and then they fell into deep thought…

text: 在这个故事中，这位40岁的中年人可以说是熟谙人性，知道人与人见面之际，第一印象往往建立在最初的六秒钟之间，而人们在观察别人时，通常又喜欢从头上看起，所以拥有良好的第一印象，这才是他真正容易受人欢迎的秘诀。
en: In this story, this forty-year-old middle-aged person can be said to know human nature thoroughly; he understands that when people meet, first impressions are often formed within the first six seconds, and that when observing others people usually like to look from the top down—so having a good first impression is the real secret of why he is so easily liked.

text: 而这位中年人之所以熟谙人性，主要就是来自他丰富的人生经验，知道理发师之间都是互相修剪对方头发，这一切令他可以做出完整而准确的判断。
en: And the reason this middle-aged person knows human nature so thoroughly mainly comes from his rich life experience—knowing that barbers cut each other's hair—and all this enables him to make complete and accurate judgements.

text: 事实上，累积足够的经验，就能够自动衍生出选择与判断的智慧，而能够具备正确判断的智慧，则是熟谙人性、避免和人性相撞的最佳自保之道。
en: In fact, accumulating enough experience can automatically give rise to the wisdom of choice and judgement; and the ability to possess the wisdom of correct judgement is the best way to protect oneself while knowing human nature and avoiding colliding with it.

text: 在任何时刻，善用经验来做出正确的反应，都可以协助我们从容面对人生、熟谙人性。
en: At any moment, making good use of experience to produce the right response can help us face life with composure and know human nature thoroughly.
